about: The case runner of ergo test --cases and scripts/examples: a case's streams and status are compared byte for byte, in a fresh folder, and a folder of no case or a failed setup.sh never passes.

mutants.name: cases-status-ignored
mutants.rule: A case whose exit status differs from expected.status (0 when absent) fails.

mutants.name: cases-stderr-not-compared
mutants.rule: A case whose stderr differs from expected.err (empty when absent) fails.

mutants.name: cases-empty-dir-passes
mutants.from:
if len(entries) == 0 {
		problems = append(problems, base+"/ holds no case")
mutants.to:
if false {
		problems = append(problems, base+"/ holds no case")
mutants.rule: A folder that holds no case fails: no tests is red.

mutants.name: cases-setup-failure-ignored
mutants.from:
if err != nil || !o.Passed() {
			what := fmt.Sprintf("setup.sh exit %d", o.Status)
mutants.to:
if err != nil {
			what := fmt.Sprintf("setup.sh exit %d", o.Status)
mutants.rule: A setup.sh that fails fails its case, and the command does not run.

mutants.name: cases-runs-in-source-folder
mutants.rule: A case runs in a fresh empty folder, HOME, never in its case folder.

mutants.name: gcoom-examples-text-only
mutants.origin: wf10 FU-gcoom r2 (moved from scripts/examples by SPLIT E2)
mutants.rule: A capped case's span-queue allocation fault is memory, not a crash.

mutants.name: cases-relative-dir-kept
mutants.origin: wf10 SPLIT E2b (MC: --cases with a relative folder could not find setup.sh)
mutants.rule: A case folder named by a relative path runs as one named absolutely: setup.sh and its CASEDIR argument resolve from the case's own folder, not the folder the case runs in.
